default.description: Build or fix from a known plan, spec, issue, or reproduction; deploys, merges, rollouts, and other production changes; anything that does not clearly fit another tier.

deep.description: Plan, research, investigate, root-cause, evaluate, or design when there is no verified plan yet; open-ended analysis, evals, and data investigation.

quick.description: Small bounded chores with an obvious path: docs, config, renames, small cosmetic edits, simple cleanups.
